ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.INTRO_TEXT: I am a passionate Fullstack Developer who completed an intensive frontend and backend development program at Developer Akademie. My journey has taught me resilience, adaptability, and the value of continuous growth. Throughout this path, I built various projects and gained hands-on experience turning ideas into functional, user-friendly web applications.
ABOUT.INTRO_CTA: Let's connect and create something amazing together!
ABOUT.FEATURE_LOCATION: Based in Erfurt, I am open to remote work and collaboration with teams from different locations. I enjoy sharing knowledge, learning from others, and contributing to successful projects.
ABOUT.FEATURE_MINDSET: I believe that learning never stops in tech. That's why I continuously expand my knowledge, explore new technologies, and challenge myself to grow as a developer.
ABOUT.FEATURE_METHOD: I approach challenges with analytical thinking, persistence, and creativity. When I encounter a problem, I break it down into manageable steps, research possible solutions, and keep refining my approach until I achieve the best result.

RIGHTS.TITLE: User rights and choices
RIGHTS.P1: At Jermaine Jérôme Bärwolf, we recognize and respect your rights regarding your personal information, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws. We are committed to ensuring you can exercise your rights effectively. Below is an overview of your rights and how you can exercise them:
RIGHTS.L1: Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR): You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you and to obtain information about how we process it.
RIGHTS.L2: Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): If you believe that any personal information we hold about you is incorrect or incomplete, you have the right to request its correction or completion.
RIGHTS.L3: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') (Art. 17 GDPR): You have the right to request the deletion of your personal information when it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, among other circumstances.
RIGHTS.L4: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal information under certain conditions.
RIGHTS.L5: Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You have the right to receive your personal information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format and to transmit those data to another controller.
RIGHTS.L6: Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): You have the right to object to the processing of your personal information, under certain conditions, including processing for direct marketing.
RIGHTS.L7: Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7(3) GDPR): Where the processing of your personal information is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
RIGHTS.L8: Right to lodge a complaint (Art. 77 GDPR): You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe our processing of your personal information violates applicable data protection laws.
RIGHTS.P2: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at jermainejerome.dev@gmail.com or +49 1794414015. We will respond to your request in accordance with applicable data protection laws and within the timeframes stipulated by those laws. Please note, in some cases, we may need to verify your identity as part of the process to ensure the security of your personal information.
